<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class CommandFailure extends RuntimeException
{
    public readonly array $lines;
    public function __construct(string|array $reason)
    {
        $this->lines = is_array($reason) ? $reason : [$reason];
        parent::__construct(implode("\n", $this->lines));
    }
}
function fail(string|array $reason): never
{
    throw new CommandFailure($reason);
}
function normalized(string $line): array
{
    return array_values(
        array_filter(
            explode(" ", strtolower($line)),
            fn(string $word): bool => $word !== "" && !in_array($word, ["the", "a", "an"], true),
        ),
    );
}

enum Direction: int
{
    case North = 0;
    case South = 1;
    case East = 2;
    case West = 3;
    case Up = 4;
    case Down = 5;
    public function word(): string
    {
        return ["north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"][$this->value];
    }
    public function opposite(): self
    {
        return self::from($this->value ^ 1);
    }
    public static function parse(string $word): ?self
    {
        foreach (self::cases() as $direction) {
            if ($word === $direction->word() || $word === $direction->word()[0]) {
                return $direction;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
enum Verb: string
{
    case Go = "go";
    case Look = "look";
    case Examine = "examine";
    case Take = "take";
    case Drop = "drop";
    case Put = "put";
    case Inventory = "inventory";
    case Open = "open";
    case Close = "close";
    case Unlock = "unlock";
    case Lock = "lock";
    case Use = "use";
    case Light = "light";
    case Extinguish = "extinguish";
    case Wait = "wait";
    case Score = "score";
    case Save = "save";
    case Restore = "restore";
    case Verbose = "verbose";
    case Brief = "brief";
    public static function parse(string $word): ?self
    {
        $canonical = match ($word) {
            "go", "walk", "run" => "go",
            "look", "l" => "look",
            "examine", "x", "inspect", "read" => "examine",
            "take", "get", "grab" => "take",
            "drop", "discard" => "drop",
            "put", "insert", "place" => "put",
            "inventory", "inv", "i" => "inventory",
            "open" => "open",
            "close", "shut" => "close",
            "unlock" => "unlock",
            "lock" => "lock",
            "use", "apply" => "use",
            "light", "ignite" => "light",
            "extinguish", "douse", "snuff" => "extinguish",
            "wait", "z" => "wait",
            "score" => "score",
            "save" => "save",
            "restore", "load" => "restore",
            "verbose" => "verbose",
            "brief" => "brief",
            default => null,
        };
        return $canonical === null ? null : self::from($canonical);
    }
    public function noObjects(): bool
    {
        return in_array(
            $this,
            [
                self::Look,
                self::Inventory,
                self::Wait,
                self::Score,
                self::Save,
                self::Restore,
                self::Verbose,
                self::Brief,
            ],
            true,
        );
    }
    public function action(): bool
    {
        return in_array(
            $this,
            [
                self::Go,
                self::Take,
                self::Drop,
                self::Put,
                self::Open,
                self::Close,
                self::Unlock,
                self::Lock,
                self::Use,
                self::Light,
                self::Extinguish,
                self::Wait,
            ],
            true,
        );
    }
}
enum PlaceKind
{
    case Room;
    case Player;
    case Inside;
    case Nowhere;
}
enum ContainerState: string
{
    case Open = "open";
    case Closed = "closed";
    case Locked = "locked";
}
enum EndStatus
{
    case None;
    case Won;
    case Dead;
}
final readonly class Place
{
    public function __construct(public PlaceKind $kind, public string $id = "") {}
    public function key(): string
    {
        return $this->kind->name . ":" . $this->id;
    }
    public function equals(self $other): bool
    {
        return $this->kind === $other->kind && $this->id === $other->id;
    }
}
final readonly class ExitLink
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $destination,
        public ?string $key,
        public bool $locked,
    ) {}
}
final class Room
{
    public array $description = [];
    public function __construct(public string $name, public bool $dark) {}
}
final class Item
{
    public string $name = "";
    public int $points = 0;
    public bool $light = false,
        $fixed = false;
    public ?int $capacity = null;
    public ?string $key = null;
    public array $nouns,
        $nameWords = [],
        $details = [];
    public function __construct(public string $id, public int $weight)
    {
        $this->nouns = [$id => true];
    }
}
interface Effect {}
final readonly class MessageEffect implements Effect
{
    public function __construct(public string $text) {}
}
final readonly class OpenEffect implements Effect
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $room,
        public Direction $direction,
        public string $destination,
    ) {}
}
final readonly class MoveEffect implements Effect
{
    public function __construct(public string $item, public Place $place) {}
}
final readonly class FlagEffect implements Effect
{
    public function __construct(public string $flag, public bool $on) {}
}
final readonly class PointsEffect implements Effect
{
    public function __construct(public int $amount) {}
}
final readonly class Rule
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $first,
        public string $second,
        public ?string $flag,
        public bool $whenOn,
        public Effect $effect,
    ) {}
}
final class GameState
{
    public string $room = "";
    public array $places = [],
        $containers = [],
        $fuel = [],
        $lit = [],
        $exits = [],
        $flags = [],
        $visited = [];
    public int $bonus = 0,
        $moves = 0,
        $darkness = 0;
    public EndStatus $ended = EndStatus::None;
}
final readonly class Score
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $stored,
        public int $treasures,
        public int $points,
        public int $total,
    ) {}
}

final class Adventure
{
    private array $rooms = [],
        $items = [],
        $ids = [],
        $rules = [],
        $enterRules = [],
        $vocabulary = [];
    private GameState $state;
    private ?GameState $saved = null;
    private ?string $pronoun = null,
        $previous = null;
    private bool $verbose = false;
    private string $trophy = "";
    private int $maxWeight = 0;

    public function __construct(array $definitions)
    {
        $this->state = new GameState();
        foreach ($definitions as $line) {
            $this->define($line);
        }
        ksort($this->items, SORT_STRING);
        $this->ids = array_keys($this->items);
        foreach ($this->items as $item) {
            $this->vocabulary += $item->nouns + $item->nameWords;
        }
        $this->state->visited[$this->state->room] = true;
    }
    private function setExit(
        string $room,
        Direction $direction,
        string $destination,
        ?string $key = null,
    ): void {
        $this->state->exits[$room][$direction->value] = new ExitLink(
            $destination,
            $key,
            $key !== null,
        );
    }
    private function define(string $line): void
    {
        $words = explode(" ", $line);
        $kind = $words[0];
        $id = $words[1];
        $text = fn(int $index): string => implode(" ", array_slice($words, $index));
        switch ($kind) {
            case "ROOM":
                $dark = $words[2] === "DARK";
                $this->rooms[$id] = new Room($text($dark ? 3 : 2), $dark);
                break;
            case "DESC":
                $this->rooms[$id]->description[] = $text(2);
                break;
            case "EXIT":
                $this->setExit(
                    $id,
                    Direction::parse($words[2]),
                    $words[3],
                    count($words) > 4 ? $words[5] : null,
                );
                break;
            case "ITEM":
                $item = new Item($id, (int) $words[3]);
                $this->state->places[$id] = match ($words[2]) {
                    "PLAYER" => new Place(PlaceKind::Player),
                    "NOWHERE" => new Place(PlaceKind::Nowhere),
                    default => new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $words[2]),
                };
                $this->state->fuel[$id] = 0;
                $this->state->lit[$id] = false;
                $this->state->containers[$id] = ContainerState::Open;
                $index = 4;
                if ($words[$index] === "TREASURE") {
                    $item->points = (int) $words[$index + 1];
                    $index += 2;
                }
                if ($words[$index] === "LIGHT") {
                    $item->light = true;
                    $this->state->fuel[$id] = (int) $words[$index + 1];
                    $index += 2;
                }
                if ($words[$index] === "CONTAINER") {
                    $item->capacity = (int) $words[$index + 1];
                    $index += 2;
                    if ($words[$index] === "CLOSED") {
                        $this->state->containers[$id] = ContainerState::Closed;
                        $index++;
                    }
                    if ($words[$index] === "LOCKED") {
                        $item->key = $words[$index + 1];
                        $this->state->containers[$id] = ContainerState::Locked;
                        $index += 2;
                    }
                }
                if ($words[$index] === "FIXED") {
                    $item->fixed = true;
                    $index++;
                }
                $item->name = $text($index);
                $item->nameWords = array_fill_keys(array_slice($words, $index), true);
                $this->items[$id] = $item;
                break;
            case "INSIDE":
                $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $words[2]);
                break;
            case "ALIAS":
                $this->items[$id]->nouns[$words[2]] = true;
                break;
            case "DETAIL":
                $this->items[$id]->details[] = $text(2);
                break;
            case "RULE":
            case "ENTER":
                $index = $kind === "RULE" ? 3 : 2;
                $flag = null;
                $whenOn = true;
                if ($words[$index] === "IF" || $words[$index] === "UNLESS") {
                    $whenOn = $words[$index] === "IF";
                    $flag = $words[$index + 1];
                    $index += 2;
                }
                $effectName = $words[$index++];
                $effect = match ($effectName) {
                    "MESSAGE" => new MessageEffect($text($index)),
                    "OPEN" => new OpenEffect(
                        $words[$index],
                        Direction::parse($words[$index + 1]),
                        $words[$index + 2],
                    ),
                    "REMOVE" => new MoveEffect($words[$index], new Place(PlaceKind::Nowhere)),
                    "ADD" => new MoveEffect(
                        $words[$index],
                        new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $words[$index + 1]),
                    ),
                    "SET", "CLEAR" => new FlagEffect($words[$index], $effectName === "SET"),
                    default => new PointsEffect((int) $words[$index]),
                };
                $rule = new Rule($id, $kind === "RULE" ? $words[2] : "", $flag, $whenOn, $effect);
                if ($kind === "RULE") {
                    $this->rules[] = $rule;
                } else {
                    $this->enterRules[] = $rule;
                }
                break;
            case "TROPHY":
                $this->trophy = $id;
                break;
            case "START":
                $this->state->room = $id;
                break;
            case "MAXWEIGHT":
                $this->maxWeight = (int) $id;
                break;
        }
    }
    private function contents(Place $place): array
    {
        return array_values(
            array_filter(
                $this->ids,
                fn(string $id): bool => $this->state->places[$id]->equals($place),
            ),
        );
    }
    private function children(): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($this->ids as $id) {
            $result[$this->state->places[$id]->key()][] = $id;
        }
        return $result;
    }
    private function isOpen(string $id): bool
    {
        return $this->items[$id]->capacity !== null &&
            $this->state->containers[$id] === ContainerState::Open;
    }
    private function reachable(Place $place): array
    {
        $children = $this->children();
        $result = [];
        $visit = function (Place $place) use ($children, &$result, &$visit): void {
            foreach ($children[$place->key()] ?? [] as $id) {
                $result[$id] = true;
                if ($this->isOpen($id)) {
                    $visit(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id));
                }
            }
        };
        $visit($place);
        return $result;
    }
    private function carried(): array
    {
        return $this->reachable(new Place(PlaceKind::Player));
    }
    private function isCarried(string $id): bool
    {
        $carried = $this->carried();
        return isset($carried[$id]);
    }
    private function roomItems(): array
    {
        return $this->reachable(new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $this->state->room));
    }
    private function isLit(): bool
    {
        if (!$this->rooms[$this->state->room]->dark) {
            return true;
        }
        foreach ($this->carried() + $this->roomItems() as $id => $_) {
            if ($this->state->lit[$id]) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    private function visible(): array
    {
        return $this->isLit() ? $this->carried() + $this->roomItems() : $this->carried();
    }
    private function weights(): array
    {
        $children = $this->children();
        $result = [];
        $total = function (string $id) use ($children, &$result, &$total): int {
            if (isset($result[$id])) {
                return $result[$id];
            }
            $weight = $this->items[$id]->weight;
            foreach ($children[new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id)->key()] ?? [] as $child) {
                $weight += $total($child);
            }
            return $result[$id] = $weight;
        };
        foreach ($this->ids as $id) {
            $total($id);
        }
        return $result;
    }
    private function totalWeight(string $id): int
    {
        return $this->weights()[$id];
    }
    private function contentWeight(string $id): int
    {
        return $this->totalWeight($id) - $this->items[$id]->weight;
    }
    private function carriedWeight(): int
    {
        $weights = $this->weights();
        $result = 0;
        foreach ($this->contents(new Place(PlaceKind::Player)) as $id) {
            $result += $weights[$id];
        }
        return $result;
    }
    private function nestedIn(string $id, string $ancestor): bool
    {
        for (
            $place = $this->state->places[$id];
            $place->kind === PlaceKind::Inside;
            $place = $this->state->places[$place->id]
        ) {
            if ($place->id === $ancestor) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    private function score(): Score
    {
        $stored = 0;
        $treasures = 0;
        $points = 0;
        foreach ($this->items as $id => $item) {
            if ($item->points > 0) {
                $treasures++;
                $place = $this->state->places[$id];
                while ($place->kind === PlaceKind::Inside) {
                    $place = $this->state->places[$place->id];
                }
                if ($place->kind === PlaceKind::Room && $place->id === $this->trophy) {
                    $stored++;
                    $points += $item->points;
                }
            }
        }
        return new Score($stored, $treasures, $points, $points + $this->state->bonus);
    }
    private function display(string $id): string
    {
        $item = $this->items[$id];
        $annotations = [];
        if ($item->capacity !== null) {
            $annotations[] = $this->state->containers[$id]->value;
        }
        if ($item->light && $this->state->lit[$id]) {
            $annotations[] = "lit";
        }
        return $item->name . ($annotations === [] ? "" : " (" . implode(", ", $annotations) . ")");
    }
    private function tree(Place $place): array
    {
        $children = $this->children();
        $lines = [];
        $visit = function (Place $place, int $depth) use ($children, &$lines, &$visit): void {
            foreach ($children[$place->key()] ?? [] as $id) {
                $lines[] = str_repeat("  ", $depth) . $this->display($id);
                if ($this->isOpen($id)) {
                    $visit(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id), $depth + 1);
                }
            }
        };
        $visit($place, 1);
        return $lines;
    }
    public function describe(bool $full = true): array
    {
        if (!$this->isLit()) {
            return ["It is pitch dark."];
        }
        $room = $this->rooms[$this->state->room];
        $lines = [$room->name];
        if ($full) {
            array_push($lines, ...$room->description);
        }
        $exits = [];
        foreach (Direction::cases() as $direction) {
            $exit = $this->state->exits[$this->state->room][$direction->value] ?? null;
            if ($exit !== null) {
                $exits[] = $direction->word() . ($exit->locked ? " (locked)" : "");
            }
        }
        $lines[] = "Exits: " . ($exits === [] ? "none" : implode(", ", $exits));
        $floor = new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $this->state->room);
        if ($this->contents($floor) !== []) {
            array_push($lines, "You see:", ...$this->tree($floor));
        }
        return $lines;
    }
    private function resolve(array $phrase): string
    {
        $visible = $this->visible();
        if ($phrase === ["it"]) {
            if ($this->pronoun === null) {
                fail('I don\'t know what "it" refers to.');
            }
            if (!isset($visible[$this->pronoun])) {
                fail("You can't see any such thing.");
            }
            return $this->pronoun;
        }
        foreach ($phrase as $word) {
            if (!isset($this->vocabulary[$word])) {
                fail('I don\'t know the word "' . $word . '".');
            }
        }
        $matches = [];
        $last = $phrase[count($phrase) - 1];
        foreach ($this->items as $id => $item) {
            if (!isset($visible[$id]) || !isset($item->nouns[$last])) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach (array_slice($phrase, 0, -1) as $word) {
                if (!isset($item->nameWords[$word])) {
                    continue 2;
                }
            }
            $matches[] = $id;
        }
        if ($matches === []) {
            fail("You can't see any such thing.");
        }
        if (count($matches) > 1) {
            fail(
                "Which do you mean: " .
                    implode(
                        ", ",
                        array_map(fn(string $id): string => $this->items[$id]->name, $matches),
                    ) .
                    "?",
            );
        }
        return $this->pronoun = $matches[0];
    }
    private function runRules(array $rules, string $first, string $second = ""): array
    {
        $lines = [];
        $executed = 0;
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if (
                $rule->first !== $first ||
                $rule->second !== $second ||
                ($rule->flag !== null && isset($this->state->flags[$rule->flag]) !== $rule->whenOn)
            ) {
                continue;
            }
            $executed++;
            $effect = $rule->effect;
            if ($effect instanceof MessageEffect) {
                $lines[] = $effect->text;
            } elseif ($effect instanceof OpenEffect) {
                $this->setExit($effect->room, $effect->direction, $effect->destination);
            } elseif ($effect instanceof MoveEffect) {
                $this->state->places[$effect->item] = $effect->place;
            } elseif ($effect instanceof FlagEffect) {
                if ($effect->on) {
                    $this->state->flags[$effect->flag] = true;
                } else {
                    unset($this->state->flags[$effect->flag]);
                }
            } elseif ($effect instanceof PointsEffect) {
                $this->state->bonus += $effect->amount;
            }
        }
        return [$lines, $executed];
    }
    private function requireContainer(string $id): void
    {
        $name = $this->items[$id]->name;
        if ($this->items[$id]->capacity === null) {
            fail("The $name is not a container.");
        }
        if (!$this->isOpen($id)) {
            fail("The $name is closed.");
        }
    }
    private function take(array $first, ?array $second): array
    {
        if (!$this->isLit()) {
            fail("It is pitch dark.");
        }
        $container = null;
        $source = new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $this->state->room);
        if ($second !== null) {
            $container = $this->resolve($second);
            $this->requireContainer($container);
            $source = new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $container);
        }
        if ($first === ["all"]) {
            $candidates = array_values(
                array_filter(
                    $this->contents($source),
                    fn(string $id): bool => !$this->items[$id]->fixed,
                ),
            );
            if ($candidates === []) {
                fail(
                    $container === null
                        ? "There is nothing here to take."
                        : "There is nothing in the " . $this->items[$container]->name . " to take.",
                );
            }
            $lines = [];
            $taken = false;
            foreach ($candidates as $id) {
                $outcome = "You can't carry any more.";
                if (
                    $this->isCarried($id) ||
                    $this->carriedWeight() + $this->totalWeight($id) <= $this->maxWeight
                ) {
                    $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Player);
                    $outcome = "Taken.";
                    $taken = true;
                }
                $lines[] = $this->items[$id]->name . ": " . $outcome;
            }
            if (!$taken) {
                fail($lines);
            }
            return $lines;
        }
        $id = $this->resolve($first);
        $name = $this->items[$id]->name;
        if ($container !== null && !$this->state->places[$id]->equals($source)) {
            fail("The $name is not in the " . $this->items[$container]->name . ".");
        }
        if ($this->state->places[$id]->kind === PlaceKind::Player) {
            fail("You already have the $name.");
        }
        if ($this->items[$id]->fixed) {
            fail("The $name is fixed in place.");
        }
        if (
            !$this->isCarried($id) &&
            $this->carriedWeight() + $this->totalWeight($id) > $this->maxWeight
        ) {
            fail("You can't carry any more.");
        }
        $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Player);
        return ["Taken."];
    }
    private function drop(array $phrase): array
    {
        if ($phrase === ["all"]) {
            $candidates = $this->contents(new Place(PlaceKind::Player));
            if ($candidates === []) {
                fail("You are empty-handed.");
            }
            $lines = [];
            foreach ($candidates as $id) {
                $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $this->state->room);
                $lines[] = $this->items[$id]->name . ": Dropped.";
            }
            return $lines;
        }
        $id = $this->resolve($phrase);
        if (!$this->isCarried($id)) {
            fail("You aren't carrying the " . $this->items[$id]->name . ".");
        }
        $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Room, $this->state->room);
        return ["Dropped."];
    }
    private function putItem(string $id, string $container): ?string
    {
        $name = $this->items[$id]->name;
        $target = $this->items[$container];
        if ($this->nestedIn($container, $id)) {
            return "The {$target->name} is inside the $name.";
        }
        if ($this->state->places[$id]->equals(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $container))) {
            return "The $name is already in the {$target->name}.";
        }
        $weight =
            $this->contentWeight($container) +
            ($this->nestedIn($id, $container) ? 0 : $this->totalWeight($id));
        if ($weight > $target->capacity) {
            return "The $name doesn't fit in the {$target->name}.";
        }
        $this->state->places[$id] = new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $container);
        return null;
    }
    private function put(array $first, array $second): array
    {
        if ($first === ["all"]) {
            $target = $this->resolve($second);
            $this->requireContainer($target);
            $candidates = array_values(
                array_filter(
                    $this->contents(new Place(PlaceKind::Player)),
                    fn(string $id): bool => $id !== $target,
                ),
            );
            if ($candidates === []) {
                fail("You have nothing to put in the " . $this->items[$target]->name . ".");
            }
            $lines = [];
            $succeeded = false;
            foreach ($candidates as $id) {
                $reason = $this->putItem($id, $target);
                if ($reason === null) {
                    $succeeded = true;
                }
                $lines[] = $this->items[$id]->name . ": " . ($reason ?? "Done.");
            }
            if (!$succeeded) {
                fail($lines);
            }
            return $lines;
        }
        $id = $this->resolve($first);
        $target = $this->resolve($second);
        $name = $this->items[$id]->name;
        if (!$this->isCarried($id)) {
            fail("You aren't carrying the $name.");
        }
        if ($id === $target) {
            fail("You can't put the $name inside itself.");
        }
        $this->requireContainer($target);
        $reason = $this->putItem($id, $target);
        if ($reason !== null) {
            fail($reason);
        }
        return ["You put the $name in the " . $this->items[$target]->name . "."];
    }
    private function keyCheck(string $key, ?array $phrase): array
    {
        if ($phrase !== null) {
            $id = $this->resolve($phrase);
            $name = $this->items[$id]->name;
            if (!$this->isCarried($id)) {
                fail("You aren't carrying the $name.");
            }
            if ($id !== $key) {
                fail("The $name doesn't fit.");
            }
            return [];
        }
        if (!$this->isCarried($key)) {
            fail("You don't have the right key.");
        }
        return ["(with the " . $this->items[$key]->name . ")"];
    }
    private function lockObject(array $first, ?array $second, bool $locking): array
    {
        $direction = count($first) === 1 ? Direction::parse($first[0]) : null;
        if ($direction !== null) {
            $room = $this->state->room;
            $name = $direction->word();
            $exit = $this->state->exits[$room][$direction->value] ?? null;
            if ($exit === null) {
                fail("There is no exit $name.");
            }
            if ($exit->key === null) {
                fail("The way $name has no lock.");
            }
            if ($exit->locked === $locking) {
                fail("The way $name is " . ($locking ? "already locked." : "not locked."));
            }
            $lines = $this->keyCheck($exit->key, $second);
            $this->state->exits[$room][$direction->value] = new ExitLink(
                $exit->destination,
                $exit->key,
                $locking,
            );
            $opposite = $direction->opposite();
            $back = $this->state->exits[$exit->destination][$opposite->value] ?? null;
            if ($back !== null && $back->destination === $room && $back->key === $exit->key) {
                $this->state->exits[$exit->destination][$opposite->value] = new ExitLink(
                    $back->destination,
                    $back->key,
                    $locking,
                );
            }
        } else {
            $id = $this->resolve($first);
            $item = $this->items[$id];
            $value = $this->state->containers[$id];
            if ($item->capacity === null || $item->key === null) {
                fail("The {$item->name} has no lock.");
            }
            if (($value === ContainerState::Locked) === $locking) {
                fail("The {$item->name} is " . ($locking ? "already locked." : "not locked."));
            }
            if ($locking && $value === ContainerState::Open) {
                fail("You must close the {$item->name} first.");
            }
            $lines = $this->keyCheck($item->key, $second);
            $this->state->containers[$id] = $locking
                ? ContainerState::Locked
                : ContainerState::Closed;
        }
        $lines[] = $locking ? "Locked." : "Unlocked.";
        return $lines;
    }
    private function execute(Verb $verb, array $first, ?array $second): array
    {
        switch ($verb) {
            case Verb::Look:
                return $this->describe();
            case Verb::Inventory:
                $player = new Place(PlaceKind::Player);
                if ($this->contents($player) === []) {
                    return ["You are empty-handed."];
                }
                return array_merge(["You are carrying:"], $this->tree($player), [
                    "Total weight: " . $this->carriedWeight() . "/" . $this->maxWeight,
                ]);
            case Verb::Wait:
                return ["Time passes."];
            case Verb::Score:
                $score = $this->score();
                return [
                    "You have scored {$score->total} points (treasure {$score->points}, bonus {$this->state->bonus}) in {$this->state->moves} moves.",
                    "Treasures stored: {$score->stored} of {$score->treasures}.",
                ];
            case Verb::Save:
                $this->saved = clone $this->state;
                return ["Game saved."];
            case Verb::Restore:
                if ($this->saved === null) {
                    fail("There is no saved game.");
                }
                $this->state = clone $this->saved;
                return array_merge(["Game restored."], $this->describe());
            case Verb::Verbose:
                $this->verbose = true;
                return ["Verbose mode."];
            case Verb::Brief:
                $this->verbose = false;
                return ["Brief mode."];
            case Verb::Take:
                return $this->take($first, $second);
            case Verb::Drop:
                return $this->drop($first);
            case Verb::Put:
                return $this->put($first, $second);
            case Verb::Unlock:
            case Verb::Lock:
                return $this->lockObject($first, $second, $verb === Verb::Lock);
            case Verb::Use:
                $id = $this->resolve($first);
                $target = $this->resolve($second);
                if (!$this->isCarried($id)) {
                    fail("You aren't carrying the " . $this->items[$id]->name . ".");
                }
                [$lines, $executed] = $this->runRules($this->rules, $id, $target);
                if ($executed === 0) {
                    fail("Nothing happens.");
                }
                return $lines === [] ? ["Done."] : $lines;
            default:
                break;
        }
        $id = $this->resolve($first);
        $item = $this->items[$id];
        $value = $this->state->containers[$id];
        switch ($verb) {
            case Verb::Examine:
                $lines =
                    $item->details === []
                        ? ["You see nothing special about the {$item->name}."]
                        : $item->details;
                if ($item->light) {
                    $lines[] =
                        "It is " .
                        ($this->state->lit[$id] ? "lit" : "unlit") .
                        " (fuel " .
                        $this->state->fuel[$id] .
                        ").";
                }
                if ($item->capacity !== null) {
                    if ($value !== ContainerState::Open) {
                        $lines[] = "It is {$value->value}.";
                    } elseif ($this->contents(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id)) === []) {
                        $lines[] = "It is empty.";
                    } else {
                        array_push(
                            $lines,
                            "It contains:",
                            ...$this->tree(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id)),
                        );
                    }
                }
                if ($item->points > 0) {
                    $lines[] = "It is a treasure worth {$item->points} points.";
                }
                $lines[] = "It weighs " . $this->totalWeight($id) . ".";
                return $lines;
            case Verb::Open:
                if ($item->capacity === null) {
                    fail("You can't open the {$item->name}.");
                }
                if ($value === ContainerState::Open) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} is already open.");
                }
                if ($value === ContainerState::Locked) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} is locked.");
                }
                $this->state->containers[$id] = ContainerState::Open;
                $names = array_map(
                    fn(string $child): string => $this->items[$child]->name,
                    $this->contents(new Place(PlaceKind::Inside, $id)),
                );
                return $names === []
                    ? ["Opened."]
                    : ["Opening the {$item->name} reveals " . implode(", ", $names) . "."];
            case Verb::Close:
                if ($item->capacity === null) {
                    fail("You can't close the {$item->name}.");
                }
                if ($value !== ContainerState::Open) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} is already closed.");
                }
                $this->state->containers[$id] = ContainerState::Closed;
                return ["Closed."];
            case Verb::Light:
                if (!$item->light) {
                    fail("You can't light the {$item->name}.");
                }
                if ($this->state->lit[$id]) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} is already lit.");
                }
                if ($this->state->fuel[$id] === 0) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} has no fuel.");
                }
                $this->state->lit[$id] = true;
                return ["The {$item->name} is now lit."];
            case Verb::Extinguish:
                if (!$item->light) {
                    fail("You can't extinguish the {$item->name}.");
                }
                if (!$this->state->lit[$id]) {
                    fail("The {$item->name} is not lit.");
                }
                $this->state->lit[$id] = false;
                return ["The {$item->name} is now out."];
            default:
                return [];
        }
    }
    private function endTurn(bool $baseline): array
    {
        $this->state->moves++;
        $nearby = $this->carried() + $this->roomItems();
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($this->ids as $id) {
            if ($this->state->lit[$id]) {
                $this->state->fuel[$id]--;
                if ($this->state->fuel[$id] === 0) {
                    $this->state->lit[$id] = false;
                    if (isset($nearby[$id])) {
                        $lines[] = "The " . $this->items[$id]->name . " goes out.";
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        $lit = $this->isLit();
        if ($baseline && !$lit) {
            $lines[] = "It is now pitch dark.";
        } elseif (!$baseline && $lit) {
            array_push($lines, ...$this->describe());
        }
        $this->state->darkness = $lit ? 0 : $this->state->darkness + 1;
        if ($this->state->darkness === 2) {
            $lines[] = "You hear something moving in the dark.";
        }
        if ($this->state->darkness === 3) {
            $this->state->ended = EndStatus::Dead;
        }
        $score = $this->score();
        if (
            $this->state->ended === EndStatus::None &&
            $score->treasures > 0 &&
            $score->stored === $score->treasures
        ) {
            $this->state->ended = EndStatus::Won;
        }
        if ($this->state->ended !== EndStatus::None) {
            $lines[] =
                $this->state->ended === EndStatus::Dead
                    ? "*** You have died ***"
                    : "*** You have won ***";
            $lines[] = "You scored {$score->total} points in {$this->state->moves} moves.";
        }
        return $lines;
    }
    private function interpret(string $line): array
    {
        $words = normalized($line);
        if ($words === []) {
            fail("I beg your pardon?");
        }
        if (Direction::parse($words[0]) !== null) {
            array_unshift($words, "go");
        }
        $verb = Verb::parse($words[0]);
        if ($verb === null) {
            fail('I don\'t know the verb "' . $words[0] . '".');
        }
        if ($this->state->ended !== EndStatus::None && $verb !== Verb::Restore) {
            fail("The game is over.");
        }
        $rest = array_slice($words, 1);
        if ($verb === Verb::Look && $rest !== []) {
            if ($rest[0] !== "at") {
                fail("I don't understand that.");
            }
            $verb = Verb::Examine;
            $rest = array_slice($rest, 1);
        }
        $first = $rest;
        $second = null;
        if ($verb->noObjects()) {
            if ($rest !== []) {
                fail("I don't understand that.");
            }
        } else {
            if ($rest === []) {
                fail(
                    $verb === Verb::Go
                        ? "Which way do you want to go?"
                        : "What do you want to " . $verb->value . "?",
                );
            }
            if ($verb === Verb::Go) {
                if (count($rest) !== 1 || Direction::parse($rest[0]) === null) {
                    fail("I don't understand that.");
                }
            } else {
                $prepositions = [];
                if ($verb === Verb::Put) {
                    $prepositions = ["in", "into"];
                } elseif ($verb === Verb::Use) {
                    $prepositions = ["on", "with"];
                } elseif (
                    ($verb === Verb::Unlock || $verb === Verb::Lock) &&
                    in_array("with", $rest, true)
                ) {
                    $prepositions = ["with"];
                } elseif ($verb === Verb::Take && in_array("from", $rest, true)) {
                    $prepositions = ["from"];
                }
                if ($prepositions !== []) {
                    $index = 0;
                    while ($index < count($rest) && !in_array($rest[$index], $prepositions, true)) {
                        $index++;
                    }
                    if ($index === 0 || $index + 1 >= count($rest)) {
                        fail("I don't understand that.");
                    }
                    $first = array_slice($rest, 0, $index);
                    $second = array_slice($rest, $index + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        $baseline = $this->isLit();
        if ($verb === Verb::Go) {
            $direction = Direction::parse($rest[0]);
            $exit = $this->state->exits[$this->state->room][$direction->value] ?? null;
            if ($exit === null) {
                fail("You can't go that way.");
            }
            if ($exit->locked) {
                fail("The way " . $direction->word() . " is locked.");
            }
            $this->state->room = $exit->destination;
            $baseline = $this->isLit();
            $lines = $this->describe(
                $this->verbose || !isset($this->state->visited[$this->state->room]),
            );
            $this->state->visited[$this->state->room] = true;
            [$extra] = $this->runRules($this->enterRules, $this->state->room);
            array_push($lines, ...$extra);
        } else {
            $lines = $this->execute($verb, $first, $second);
        }
        if ($verb->action()) {
            array_push($lines, ...$this->endTurn($baseline));
        }
        return $lines;
    }
    public function command(string $line): array
    {
        try {
            $words = normalized($line);
            if ($words !== [] && ($words[0] === "again" || $words[0] === "g")) {
                if (count($words) !== 1) {
                    fail("I don't understand that.");
                }
                if ($this->previous === null) {
                    fail("There is nothing to repeat.");
                }
                return $this->interpret($this->previous);
            }
            $this->previous = $line;
            return $this->interpret($line);
        } catch (CommandFailure $failure) {
            return $failure->lines;
        }
    }
    public function finalScore(): string
    {
        return "Final score: " .
            $this->score()->total .
            " points in " .
            $this->state->moves .
            " moves.";
    }
}

$definitions = [];
while (($line = fgets(STDIN)) !== false) {
    $line = rtrim($line, "\r\n");
    if ($line === "BEGIN") {
        break;
    }
    $definitions[] = $line;
}
$adventure = new Adventure($definitions);
foreach ($adventure->describe() as $line) {
    echo $line, "\n";
}
while (($line = fgets(STDIN)) !== false) {
    $line = rtrim($line, "\r\n");
    if ($line === "QUIT") {
        echo $adventure->finalScore(), "\n";
        break;
    }
    echo "> ", $line, "\n";
    foreach ($adventure->command($line) as $output) {
        echo $output, "\n";
    }
}
